opinions.feedback: The proposed cases correctly cover the menu items and theme existence, but they completely miss test cases for requirements R-176 and R-177 regarding the visual display of the Classic and Modern themes. Furthermore, requirements R-180 and R-181 place Classic and Modern items under the View menu, which might conflict or overlap with R-175's assertion that they exist under theme preferences. Please add visual verification cases for R-176 and R-177 and clarify the menu structure.
